newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka issues Jun 21-22 jet, gas oil buy tender.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka issues Jun 21-22 jet, gas oil buy tender.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil and jet fuel for June 21-22 delivery, cost and freight (c-and-f) Colombo, industry sources said on Wednesday.
The tender which seeks around 220,000 barrels of 1.0-percent sulphur gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel will close on June 4 and will be valid for two days.
Sri Lanka's other tender to buy 220,000 barrels of gas oil and 80,000 barrels of jet fuel for June 10-11 delivery will close later Wednesday and is valid for two days.

CPC has raised its middle distillate import due to an unexpected two week shutdown of its 50,000-60,000 barrels-per-day Sapugaskanda refinery after an accident at its single mooring system which stopped crude deliveries.

In its last tender for June 1-2 delivery, CPC bought from Dutch trader Vitol 250,000 barrels of gas oil at a discount of 14 cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes and jet fuel at five-cent discount, c-and-f Colombo.
